data.Name: Omega Sør Alfa
data.Description: Brent Group reservoir (Tarbert + Rannoch formations). Discovery well: 34/4-19 S. Water depth 381 m. Block 34/4, Licence PL057, Snorre area, Northern North Sea.

data.Name: Omega Sør - Well Planning Assessment Workflow
data.Description: Well cost estimate → drilling design → injectivity assessment → pilot well dependency evaluation → WPC evidence assembly

data.Name: Omega Sør WPC - Well Planning Assessment
data.Description: 65-realisation Monte Carlo volumetrics + well design optimisation + Ba scale decision tree evaluation

Parameters.Title: ReservoirModel
Parameters.Selection: Brent Group: Tarbert (upper, shallow-marine) + Rannoch (lower, higher perm uncertainty)

Parameters.Title: WellDesign
Parameters.Selection: Producer: CAP-X sidetrack 34/4-19 S, perforate Tarbert+Rannoch. Injector: 4-slot template sidetrack, Tarbert only.

Parameters.Title: InjectivityAssessment
Parameters.Selection: Rannoch <50 mD, injection pressure limited. Cold-water injection + fracturing after depletion contingency.

Parameters.Title: ScaleRiskAssessment
Parameters.Selection: Ba decision tree: <50 mg/L proceed, 50-100 evaluate depletion/GAG, >100 concept change.

Parameters.Title: Volumetrics
Parameters.Selection: STOIIP P50 19.3 MSm3 (Tarbert 7.2 + Rannoch 10.8). Recoverable P50 5.4 MSm3, RF 28.5%.

data.Name: Omega Sør WPC - Volumes (65-realisation Monte Carlo)
data.Description: Static in-place volumes per zone: Tarbert ~7.2 MSm3, Rannoch ~10.8 MSm3. OWC range: ODT 3772.5 m vs mean 3860 m.

data.Name: Barium scale risk (PIMS #00061)
data.Description: Decision tree: Ba <50 mg/L → proceed; 50–100 mg/L → evaluate depletion/GAG; >100 mg/L → concept change. Key WPC risk driver.

data.Name: Low permeability & injectivity
data.Description: Rannoch Fm permeability <50 mD, injection pressure limited. Requires cold-water injection + fracturing after depletion, IMR vessel possible.

data.Name: Volume & structural uncertainty
data.Description: OWC range (ODT 3772.5 m vs mean 3860 m). STOIIP range P90 15.8 – P10 22.9 MSm3. Deformation bands near ISF may restrict drainage.

data.Name: Drilling & completion risk
data.Description: 9⅝" shoe placement decision, Hordaland flow unit P&A risk. Stratigraphy confirmation needed from pilot well.

data.Name: Schedule & cost overrun
data.Description: Robustness scenario: +20% CAPEX, -10% production, +1 year delay still economic (break-even 25 USD/bbl headroom).

data.Name: Omega Sør - WPC Prospect Evaluation Report
data.Description: Full WPC evidence: reservoir characterisation, well design, Ba scale risk assessment, economics, drilling programme.

data.Name: Omega Sør WPC - Well Development Concept
data.Description: 1 producer (CAP-X sidetrack from 34/4-19 S) + 1 injector (4-slot template). Subsea tieback to Snorre N-template.

data.Name: Omega Sør WPC - Evidence Package
data.Description: Complete evidence bundle for Work Program Committee drill/defer decision

Hierarchy.Name: Risks
Hierarchy.Description: 5 risks: Ba scale, injectivity, volume, drilling, schedule

data.Name: Omega Sør – WPC Well Planning Committee Decision
data.Description: Approve 1 producer (CAP-X sidetrack) & 1 injector (4-slot template) targeting Brent Group. P50 STOIIP 19.3 MSm3, recoverable 5.4 MSm3, RF 28.5%.
data.DecisionSummary: Approve Alt-A: 1 WI (Tarbert) + 1 producer (CAP-X ST). NPV 116 MUSD, IRR 62%, CAPEX 213 MUSD, break-even 25 USD/bbl. First oil Jan 2029. Pilot well required for OWC/Ba confirmation.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-A Base: 1 WI (Tarbert) + 1 producer, 4-slot template
Alternatives.Rationale: Best NPV 116 MUSD, IRR 62%, first oil Jan 2029. Recommended.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-B Depletion: Limited injection if Ba >100 mg/L
Alt-C WAG: Gas from Snorre, upside for later
Alternatives.Rationale: Higher recovery potential but gas availability uncertain.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-D Defer: Wait for pilot well data
Alternatives.Rationale: Defer 12 months for OWC/Ba confirmation. Rig slot risk.
